SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch
REPORT
Date May 4, 1934

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. S.B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5858
Date 4 / 5 / 34
1934

Subject (in full) Communist Propaganda bearing on the "Anniversary of
Tsinan Incident - May 3" found in Yulin Road District on 3.5.34.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [Signature] D.I.

I forward herewith together with summarized
translation, a communist handbill entitled "Manifesto in
commemoration of Anniversary of Tsinan Incident - May 3,"
dated May 3, 1934, purporting to have emanated from the
Eastern District Committee of the Chinese Communist Party,
which was found in the Shanghai No.4 Cotton Mill located
at the junction of Pingliang and Tsitsihar Roads at 2.30p.m.
on May 3.

Kuh Pao-hwa
D. I.

[Signature]
Officer i/c Special Branch.

Summarized translation of a communist handbill entitled
"Manifesto in commemoration of Anniversary of Tsinan
Incident - May 3," which was obtained by the Municipal
Police in Yulin Road District on May 3, 1934.

On May 3, 1928, the Japanese imperialists
massacred the Chinese masses at Tsinan. On that date the
anti-Northern forces captured Tsinan. This aroused the ire
of the Japanese imperialists who launched an attack on that
city. The treacherous Chiang Kai-shek, instead of offering
resistance, ordered the Chinese troops to retreat thereby
a wholesale massacre was carried out on the Chinese people.

The aggression of the Japanese and other
imperialists in China is being intensified daily, and her
political situation is at stake. Apart from adopting
a treacherous policy, the slavish Kuomintang are intensifying
their oppressive campaign on the labouring masses. At
the same time, the revolutionary masses are being tortured
and massacred with the object of suppressing the "revolutionary
tide"

The entire body of revolutionary masses should
therefore unite and commemorate May 3 by strikes and riots.
Our slogans to be used on the occasion are:-
1) Declare a general strike to commemorate the May 3 Anniversary.
2) Overthrow the treacherous Kuomintang which is selling China.
3) Overthrow the Japanese and other foreign imperialists.
4) Support the anti-Imperialist and anti-Japanese Red Army.
5) Support Soviet China!

The Eastern District Committee of the
Chinese Communist Party. Dated May 3,
1934.

F. 439 Inst. 12-31.
T.H. 1000-12-31.

Report sent with one copy pamphlets, handbills or newspapers to Special Branch.

Subject (in full) Anniversary of Tsinan Incident - May 3.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名] D.I.

With reference to the attached report on the above

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
Footoo Road Station,
No. D 5858
Date May 2nd, 1934.
Date / /

Subject (in full) Rumoured Movements re May the 3rd Anniversary.

Made by D.S.I. Brownrigg Forwarded by

Sir,
With reference to the Anniversary of the Tsinan Incident on
3.5.34, certain rumours have been reported that possibly "Red
Elements" might congregate at the corner of Jessfield and Robison
Roads between 5 p.m. and 7 p.m. on said date, and from there
proceed either to the Foo Foong Flour Mill, No.25 Mokanshan Road,
or to the No. 9 Sung Sing Cotton Mill, also on Mokanshan Road.
This is precisely the same information that was received with
reference to Labour Day Movements on May the 1st.
All necessary precautions will be taken.
A copy of this report has been forwarded to the Special
Branch for their information.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
[Signature]
D.S.I.

D.D.O. "B" Division.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（左侧手写批注：If the demonstration
is not actually
made it is not for it to
be prevented.
J.B.）

* See D. 5815

J. 2
D.I. Kuk.
[Signature]
In absence.
CDS 155 & C.DC. 280
details to keep observation.
Kuk
